summary_1line: Vidura teaches truth, kindness, and restraint, illustrating with the wager between Virochana and Sudhanwan judged by Prahlada.

image_candidates.scene_text: Prahlada sits in judgment as the angry Virochana and the calm Brahmana Sudhanwan stand before him after wagering their lives.
Sudhanwan refuses the golden seat beside Virochana while Kesini stands nearby watching the tense exchange.
Sudhanwan demands that the defeated Virochana wash his feet before the maiden Kesini after Prahlada declares the Brahmana superior.
